svg.aria-label: An AI coding agent sends a command over Wi-Fi (MCP) to an ESP32-S3. The ESP32 is plugged into a server with a USB cable: it types the command as a USB keyboard, and the output comes back over USB serial to the agent with the exit code.
svg.text: Claude Code, Codex… any MCP client
headless is fine · BIOS · login · shell
One USB cable. Nothing to install on the target.
Works where SSH can't: no network, broken drivers, boot menus.
